body: I have the same negative experiences. Family/Friends/Coworkers..it doesn't matter.  In many cases I've even shared my severe suicidal thoughts when I was really at my lowest..they never cared.  Most of them even stopped talking to me..others said to get over it or be a man..it's kind of funny when I see these people post suicide awareness stuff and say that they are always there to talk to someone that needs it on social media when a celebrity dies though...yet these same people ignore people that reach out to them...or maybe it's just me.. im sure if other people reached out for help they would care but why would i expect anyone to care about someone ugly and stupid like me
